{{Quote|My father couldn't even close his eyes. Tears ran down his cheek, but his arms and his legs kept jittering. He couldn't get up. The stormtroopers dragged him and my mother out.|Kyp Durron, describing how his parents were arrested|<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />}}
The '''mother''' of [[Kyp Durron]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who lived on the colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Deyer/Legends|Deyer]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|age]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of two [[Youngling/Legends|sons]], Kyp and [[Zeth Durron]]. She and their [[Kyp Durron's father|father]] were political dissidents who spoke out against the Empire's atrocities at [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman]] and [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and were sentenced to hard labor and imprisoned in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. A year later, she and Kyp's father were caught up in a prison revolt and [[Death/Legends|executed]] by [[Moruth Doole]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who overtook the mines. The loss of his mother caused Kyp Durron great pain and contributed to his hatred of the Empire and smugglers.

==Biography==
===Parent and political prisoner===
{{Quote|The Empire ruined my life, my parents were political resisters. They marked the anniversary of the Ghorman Massacre, and they protested the destruction of Alderaan&mdash;but by that time the Emperor had lost all patience with political objections.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />}}
[[File:Planet07-SWR.png|thumb|left|200px|Deyer, where she raised her family and served as politician]]
Living on the colony [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Deyer/Legends|Deyer]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], this [[Gender/Legends|woman]] was the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of two [[Youngling/Legends|sons]]. The elder son, [[Zeth Durron]], was born<ref name="Jedi Search" /> in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]]<ref name="Birth years">In [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], [[Kyp Durron]] is eighteen years old. Since ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the book to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], he was born in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]]. ''[[Jedi Search]]'' establishes that [[Zeth Durron]] was fourteen when Kyp was eight. Since he is six years older than his brother, who was born in 7 BBY, Zeth was born in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].</ref> and her younger son [[Kyp Durron|Kyp]] was born six years later<ref name="Jedi Search" /> in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]].<ref name="Birth years" /> Along with their [[Kyp Durron's father|father]], the family lived in a peaceful [[raft]] settlement on Deyer surrounded by [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] [[Water/Legends|lakes]],<ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> where both parents served as outspoken local [[Politics/Legends|politicians.]]<ref name="Jedi Search" /> Although ultimately accepting of the Empire,<ref name="TJATS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> hearing of the atrocities committed by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] forces and the growing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against them drove her and Kyp's father to become political dissidents. They marked the anniversary of the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]]<ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> and loudly protested the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], believing that by speaking out they could moderate the Emperor's more extreme policies from within.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> They were among the colonists who unanimously voted to condemn the [[Alderaan/Legends|planet's]] destruction and request that Palpatine rescind his [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and thought their votes could influence their Emperor's decisions.<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />

She underestimated the deadly reality of the Empire<ref name="TJATS" /> and in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="1 BBY">According to ''[[Jedi Search]]'' [[Kyp Durron]] was eight when he and his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Since he is eighteen in [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], which was set in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the family must have been arrested in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] came to their home on Deyer and seized the family. In the altercation, the stormtroopers melted down unlocked the door of their family dwelling and laid waste to the home, knocking over the fiber-grown furniture and [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] both parents. The stormtrooper [[Captain/Legends|captain]] read their arrest order, which accused them of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] and restrained the parents and their son Zeth with [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun-cuffs]]. Zeth was brought to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Carida Academy/Legends|training center]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] and his mother, father and brother were brought to the [[Correctional Facility]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="Jedi Search" /> and sentenced to hard labor in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].<ref name="TJATS" />

Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Death date" /> about a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] into her sentence at the Spice Mines of Kessel, the Imperial powers there underwent an unpheaval. The [[Prison/Legends|prison]] was embroiled in revolts by the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and at the same time [[Moruth Doole]]'s [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Slaver/Legends|slave lords]] came in and took control. In the midst of the commotion, both Kyp's mother and father were [[Death/Legends|executed]] for being on the wrong side at the wrong moment, and their young son managed to survive by hiding and laying low until he was rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] years later.<ref name="Jedi Search" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|The Empire ruined my life and destroyed my family&mdash;I wouldn't mind getting a chance to strike back.|Kyp Durron|<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />}}
The loss of his parents and the suffering he and his family endured on Kessel fueled a deep sense of rage and pain in Kyp Durron, against both the Empire that originally imprisoned them and the smugglers who perpetuated their suffering and executed his mother and father.<ref name="TNEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> He felt the Empire ruined his life when they punished his parents and him for their political resistance. Durron's rage over his past was exploited by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], who used it to draw him over to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice" /> This reached a boiling point when, overcome by the dark side, he used the [[Sun Crusher]] to destroy the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] and the Academy of Carida in an act of revenge against the Empire.<ref name="Champions of the Force">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

[[File:Sun_Crusher_EGF.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kyp Durron destroyed the Carida system using the Sun Crusher in part due to his mother's death.]]
Though repentant for his genocide of the Caridan [[Star system/Legends|solar system]], Kyp Durron never forgot the execution of his mother and father at the hands of the smugglers who overthrew Imperial rule on Kessel. Partly due to the memories of their deaths, he formed the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] "[[Kyp's Dozen|Dozen-and-Two-Avengers]]" with his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] apprentice [[Miko Reglia]]<ref name="TNEGTC" /> and dedicated himself to ridding the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of smugglers and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|kypdurron|Durron, Kyp}}</ref> When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] first heard of the Dozen-and-Two's exploits, his knowledge of his old friend's parents' deaths due to smugglers immediately led Solo to worry about Durron's activities.<ref name="Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Although she was loyal to the Empire<ref name="TJATS" /> and believed its worst offenses could be fixed from within, Kyp Durron's mother was an outspoken individual. Unlike her younger son, she did not possess any special [[Force-sensitive/Legends|affinity]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Jedi Search" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kyp Durron's mother was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the [[1994]] novel ''[[Jedi Search]]'' by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], where she was mentioned as one of his two parents.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> She was later identified as mother to Durron in the 1994 novel [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']] by Anderson, the second volume in ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy]]'' and the sequel to ''Jedi Search''.<ref name="Dark Apprentice" />
